name: Multi-Vitamin and Mineral Supplement
active_ingredient: A combination of vitamins and minerals including (but not limited to): Vitamin A, Vitamin D, Vitamin E, Vitamin C, Vitamin B complex, Calcium, Magnesium, Zinc, Iron

dose_range.note: Doses vary by individual ingredient; see subpopulation limits for guidance

allowed_claims: A factor in the maintenance of good health.
Helps the body metabolize carbohydrates, fats and proteins.
An antioxidant for the maintenance of good health.
Helps the body to metabolize nutrients.
duration_of_use: Long-term use. Consult a health care practitioner if symptoms persist.

cautions: Consult a health care practitioner if symptoms persist beyond 4 weeks.
Consult a health care practitioner prior to use if you are taking medications.
Multi-vitamin products may contain iron; keep out of reach of children.
contraindications: Do not use if you are hypersensitive to any of the ingredients.

note: This is a Class 1 multi-vitamin/mineral product containing only monographed ingredients in their allowed dose ranges. Products with novel combinations or higher doses may require Class 2 or 3 review.
